projects.name: Trussardi Residence - Phase 2 - Al Furjan
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Trussardi Residences Phase II, an upscale residential development in Al Furjan, Dubai. Expanding on the success of the first phase, this phase introduces two elegant 10-story towers and an extended two-story podium, enhancing the urban landscape near Discovery Gardens metro station.

The residences feature a mix of fully furnished studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, all designed as turn-key homes equipped with high-end household appliances. The interiors are adorned with pieces from the Trussardi Casa collection, reflecting Milanese elegance.

A key highlight of the project is the enhanced podium, which includes a 350-meter jogging track, a dedicated yoga zone, and multiple sports courts, including paddle tennis. Family-friendly amenities such as a children's playground,100m pool, trampolines, and an outdoor cinema offer entertainment for all ages. Residents can also enjoy a premium food lounge offering diverse culinary options.

For fitness and wellness, the development includes two state-of-the-art gymnasiums, covering a total of 800 square meters with separate spaces for men and women. Additionally, a wellness center provides a tranquil environment for relaxation.

The project also features four floors of Class-A office spaces, designed with the same level of sophistication as the residences, catering to business professionals seeking premium workspaces.

Trussardi Residence - Phase 2 - Al Furjan is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Dubai, valued at USD 100.0 million, at design. Developed by Trussardi,Mira Development. Lead consultant Luxury Living S.R.L. (Kenzo Maison). No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Timez By Danube - Dubai Silicon Oasis
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a 42-storey residential and commercial tower with 2B+G+3P+37 floor+SF+Roof in Dubai Silicon Oasis, featuring approximately 1,000 residential units, including convertible studios, as well as 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom apartments. Designed to offer a blend of contemporary architecture and modern living, the development incorporates a sleek façade with floor-to-ceiling windows, maximizing natural light and enhancing the overall living experience.

Strategically located along Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, the development ensures seamless connectivity to key destinations, including Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai, and Business Bay. It is also in proximity to Silicon Central Mall, Dubai Safari Park, and leading educational institutions in Academic City.

The project is designed to offer a wide range of world-class amenities, fostering a vibrant and family-friendly community. Residents will have access to an infinity anti-current pool, an aquatic gym, a Jacuzzi, and wellness-focused facilities such as therapy rooms and spa areas. For families, the development features a dedicated children’s daycare, splash pads, trampoline parks, wall climbing zones, and a sandpit play area. Entertainment options include an open-air cinema, a library, and a luxurious cigar lounge.

Additional premium facilities include an indoor gym, a business center, cabana seating, sports courts, and dining outlets, ensuring a well-rounded lifestyle. The practical exteriors are designed for easy access, low maintenance, and efficient space utilization. Select apartments come with private swimming pools, adding an element of exclusivity.

With a focus on luxury, technology, and sustainability, this residential tower represents a modern living destination, offering a high standard of comfort, convenience, and investment potential in Dubai’s thriving real estate market.

Timez By Danube - Dubai Silicon Oasis is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 200.0 million, at tender. The developer is not yet recorded. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: The Cliffs - Dubai Water Canal
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of the Cliffs, an ultra-luxury development located along the Dubai Water Canal, encompassing an expansive area of 185,339 sq ft. This prestigious project will feature a collection of high-specification residences in the desirable Jumeirah area on the south side of the canal, destined to leave an enduring mark on Dubai’s skyline. The development has a built-up area of 1,595,344 sq ft and is scheduled for completion in 2028.

The architectural design showcases a cliff-like façade characterized by strong horizontal lines intermingled with softer, fluid forms. Warm, earthy tones reminiscent of local geology are complemented by bright mineral hues, creating a striking visual appeal. The Cliffs expertly blends wellness and luxury living, seamlessly integrating nature and water throughout the development. Each residence offers panoramic views of the Dubai Water Canal and Safa Park, enhancing the connection to the surrounding environment. Floor-to-ceiling windows and private terraces extend living spaces outdoors, promoting a harmonious balance between indoor comfort and natural beauty.

Thoughtfully designed elevators open directly into private lobbies at each residence, ensuring a sense of bespoke exclusivity. The development will also feature a state-of-the-art wellness club, accompanied by 250,000 sq ft of beautifully curated landscaped gardens, and a wide array of leisure and fitness amenities, including an in-house cinema, kids club, tennis courts, indoor padel courts, and terraced private decks with pool clubs in both towers.

The Cliffs - Dubai Water Canal is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 1100.0 million, at design. Developed by Palace Group. Lead consultant Kohn Pedersen Fox Associates (Kpf). No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

The project involves the construction of Émerge Residences, a premium residential development comprising 78 units, including one-, two-, and three-bedroom homes, located in the heart of Meydan Avenue, Dubai. Designed around the philosophy of well-being and longevity, the development integrates architecture, lifestyle, and community to support mindful and holistic living.

At the center of Émerge is the first branded Longevity Clubhouse, which serves as a wellness-focused amenity and lifestyle hub. The clubhouse is designed using natural materials and fluid spatial layouts that reduce stress, enhance light, and encourage effortless movement.

The residences are part of the developer’s exclusive Well-being Collection, featuring advanced wellness facilities such as contrast therapy suites with saunas and cold plunges, red light therapy chambers, cryotherapy chambers, hyperbaric oxygen therapy, and a fully integrated smart gym. Each of the 11 residences in this collection is designed as a private wellness retreat, including outdoor saunas, cold plunges, and private pools, allowing residents to integrate wellness seamlessly into their daily routines.

projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Horizon English School Town Square, a new all-through British curriculum school within the Town Square community in Dubai. The campus will offer education from FS1 through Year 13, providing premium learning opportunities for children aged 3 to 18.

The school will open in August 2027 with classes from FS1 to Year 8 for the 2027-2028 academic year, and it will expand to include Year 13 in the subsequent years. Designed to serve Town Square and surrounding communities, the development will embody the ethos, heritage, and high academic standards of Horizon English School, one of Dubai’s long-standing home-grown British curriculum schools with a 35-year legacy.

The new Town Square campus will build on the excellence of Horizon English School in Jumeirah, which is rated ‘Outstanding’ by KHDA and BSO, and has been recognised as the Happiest School in the UAE. The facility will feature modern learning spaces and be positioned as a landmark addition to the community, enhancing Dubai’s premium education offerings. Tuition fees will range from AED 49,000 for FS1 to AED 75,000 for Year 13.

Horizon English School - Town Square is a greenfield school project in Dubai, valued at USD 30.0 million, at under construction. Developed by Cognita,Nshama. No consultant recorded. Main contractor Al Rehab Building Contracting Llc. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

The project will also contribute significantly to the field of medical studies and research in general, and to cancer diseases in particular, by benefiting from the expertise of the Mass General Brigham Hospitals Network, the Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, and other scientific and research institutes in the Emirate of Sharjah, among others.

The project envisions vibrant, sustainable communities, centered around an iconic solar-panel canopy that offers shade and generates clean energy. This innovative design creates a lush microclimate, reducing temperatures by up to 4°C compared to its surroundings and enabling the hospital to achieve net-zero energy. projects.name: Madar Mall (Block E) - Aljada
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Madar Mall, a landmark retail and entertainment destination at the heart of the Aljada megaproject in Sharjah. The mall will serve as the anchor attraction and final phase of the Madar district.

Madar Mall will feature a built-up area of 3.9 million square feet, including 1.1 million square feet of gross leasable area (GLA) spread across three levels. It will house over 400 retail outlets and 80 dining options, creating a comprehensive lifestyle and shopping hub.

The mall will also include a wide range of attractions such as an 11-screen cinema, an ice rink, a flagship fitness centre, and a central observation tower with a restaurant at the top. A public square will showcase signature dancing fountains, while lush landscaped surroundings will enhance the visitor experience.

Once complete, Madar Mall is expected to welcome 20 million visitors annually, reinforcing Aljada’s role as Sharjah’s fastest-growing mixed-use community and enhancing the emirate’s position as a hub for culture, commerce, leisure, and family life.

Madar Mall (Block E) - Aljada is a greenfield shopping mall project in Sharjah, valued at USD 612.0 million, at under construction. Developed by Arada Development Llc. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

Each apartment features smart home automation, 3.2-metre-high ceilings, and premium interior finishes. It also enjoys proximity to shopping hubs like Zahia City Centre and 06 Mall, and the Sharjah Research, Technology and Innovation Park—offering seamless access to both lifestyle and business districts.

Residents can enjoy high-end interiors, AI-powered smart home automation, and over 30 premium amenities, including VR golf, cinema rooms, yoga spaces, and infinity pools. Designed to deliver a resort-inspired lifestyle, Laguna Residence combines luxury living with the tranquility of crystal-clear waters and a serene beach atmosphere.

With its cutting-edge AI technology, seamless connectivity, and iconic architecture, the project stands as a symbol of modern elegance, offering an array of stylish studio to 3-bedroom apartments tailored for a luxurious, active lifestyle.

projects.name: FashionTV Acacia - Al Marjan Island

The project involves the construction of FashionTV Acacia, a high-concept branded residential development, located on the scenic shores of Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah. The design showcases striking architecture, panoramic sea views, and an immersive aesthetic language inspired by the iconic FashionTV brand. Communal and private spaces are crafted to reflect high-fashion energy.

The interiors are marked by structured elegance—meticulously detailed with premium materials, thoughtful palettes, and proportions that capture the rhythm of contemporary living. FashionTV Acacia positions itself not merely as a residential offering, but as a bold lifestyle proposition at the intersection of fashion, functionality, and future-forward living.

projects.name: G42/Microsoft Two AI Centres
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of two artificial intelligence (AI) centers in Abu Dhabi. The first center will focus on identifying, developing, and advancing best practices and industry standards for the responsible use of AI in the Middle East and the Global South. It aims to bring together academic researchers and AI practitioners from the private sector to document and share emerging Responsible AI practices.

Additionally, the project will establish an 'AI for Good Research Lab'. The lab will support social goals such as enhancing food security and strengthening climate resilience. It will collaborate with nonprofit organizations and partners to tackle key economic and societal challenges across the Middle East and Africa. Working closely with its existing team in Nairobi, the lab will develop large language models (LLMs) for underrepresented languages, helping to bridge the global language divide. Furthermore, the lab will apply AI to high-resolution geospatial data to improve disaster preparedness and response capabilities while advancing food security and climate resilience.

G42/Microsoft Two AI Centres is a greenfield research centre project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 25.0 million, at concept. Developed by G42,Microsoft Corporation. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Il Teatro by Arada - Aljada
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a cultural complex named Il Teatro,  covering an expansive 260,000 square feet. The Il Teatro and its surrounding plaza are envisioned as a comprehensive cultural complex. The facility will host diverse performances, including opera, theatre, dance, ballet, musicals, concerts, films, art exhibitions, and festivals, alongside a 2,000-seat auditorium. The project will also feature a gallery and boutique restaurant. 

The project consists of a cylindrical concrete mass facing a multi-layered cultural plaza. The building's front is animated by a dramatic large, arched opening that establishes a compelling connection between the interior and exterior.

The elevated public space of the plaza spans two levels, floating above a water feature and housing a large outdoor amphitheater facing Il Teatro. Designed to inspire local artists and the growing creative community in the UAE, the plaza will offer a multi-dimensional experience through various events and activities.

The project holds a prominent position within Aljada, strategically located on the main access road leading into the master community. Residents residing in the creative district will have convenient access to Il Teatro through two 'green spines' or urban parks adorned with lush foliage and dense tree coverage. Workshops, artist studios, and cafes facing these parks on both sides contribute to a vibrant and inspiring environment. Those living in the neighborhood will also benefit from a diverse calendar of events, activations, performances, and exhibitions, all just a short walk from their residences.

Il Teatro by Arada - Aljada is a greenfield cinema / theatre / auditorium project in Sharjah, valued at USD 80.0 million, at design. Developed by Arada. Lead consultant Tadao Ando Architect & Associates,Aea Consulting. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Carmona - Phase 8 - Bloom Living
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a large-scale residential community within Bloom Living in Abu Dhabi, offering an upscale and fully integrated living experience. Designed with timeless Mediterranean Spanish architecture, the development features stylish and spacious three-bedroom townhouses, blending indoor and outdoor living through open floor plans, efficiently designed kitchens, and elegant finishes.

Carmona provides residents with access to a range of top-class amenities, fostering a vibrant and family-friendly atmosphere. The community is designed with interconnected parks, walking and running tracks, and cycling paths, promoting an active lifestyle. A large central lake serves as the focal point, with designated trails for walking, jogging, and cycling. Residents can also enjoy multi-purpose amphitheaters and scenic plazas for social gatherings and leisure activities.

The development includes a well-equipped community clubhouse, multiple state-of-the-art gymnasiums, and swimming pools for both adults and children. Families benefit from dedicated kids’ play areas, BBQ zones, and round-the-clock security services. The Town Center within Bloom Living offers a variety of retail options, cafés, and restaurants, ensuring convenient access to everyday needs. Additional features include male and female prayer halls, places of worship, and two international schools, making it a self-sustained, well-balanced community.

Carmona - Phase 8 - Bloom Living is a greenfield low rise (1 -3) project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 200.0 million, at concept. Developed by Bloom Holding Pjsc. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Esme Beach Residences - Dubai Island A
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Esmé Beach Residences, a prestigious residential development by Elysian Developments, located on Island A of the visionary Dubai Islands. This luxurious complex offers a selection of 109 meticulously designed units, including 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each featuring private terraces for ultimate privacy. Spanning a total construction area of 266,000 sq ft, Esmé Beach Residences combines expansive living spaces with 23,000 sq ft of thoughtfully designed amenities, focusing on well-being, functionality, and modern living.

Esmé Beach Residences is strategically located on the beachside of Dubai Islands A, offering residents both tranquility and effortless connectivity to major Dubai landmarks, such as Downtown Dubai. A new bridge to the mainland ensures convenient access to these iconic areas. The architecture of the development features an ocean-inspired façade with curved walls that reflect the natural beauty of the Arabian Gulf. This stunning design blends contemporary elegance with local natural elements, creating a visually appealing and functional structure that respects the surrounding environment.

The residences at Esmé Beach offer expansive living areas designed for comfort and convenience. Equipped with smart home technology, these homes provide residents the ability to control lighting, curtains, and electronics with ease. From the sixth floor and above, the apartments boast unobstructed, panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf. The interior design incorporates organic materials and a muted color palette, creating a serene atmosphere inspired by the natural surroundings of the Dubai Islands.

In terms of amenities, Esmé Beach Residences offers a range of premium facilities, including a rooftop lap pool with aqua cycling equipment, wellness zones with saunas, cold plunges, and experience showers, as well as family-friendly pool areas with poolside cabanas. Fitness enthusiasts can enjoy outdoor CrossFit areas, while residents can also take advantage of cycling and jogging trails. The development includes retail outlets, restaurants, and supermarkets to meet everyday needs. Additionally, 24x7 security, parking facilities, and dedicated kids' play areas enhance the comfort and convenience of residents.

At the heart of Esmé Beach Residences is a focus on well-being. The development incorporates amenities such as contrast therapy zones and purified water systems, designed to promote both physical and mental health. The project is not only a residential development but also a lifestyle choice, offering a holistic approach to living that aligns with the demands of modern families and individuals. With its strategic location and emphasis on wellness, Esmé Beach Residences is poised to become a sought-after address in Dubai, setting a new standard for luxury living in the city.

projects.name: Treppan Tower - Jumeirah Village Triangle
projects.description: The project involves the construction of a 32-storey residential tower located in Jumeirah Village Triangle, Dubai. Branded under Treppan Living, the tower will feature 264 fully furnished one- and two-bedroom apartments, as well as a limited number of three-bedroom sky villas, with unit sizes ranging from 479 to 2,916 square feet. Interior design elements include bespoke cabinetry, sculptural lighting, and the use of natural materials and refined textures that create a minimalist yet warm aesthetic. The tower incorporates a sustainability-driven infrastructure, including AI-powered smart home automation, radiant cooling technology, and a proprietary Smart Air Handling Unit (SAHU) system to ensure optimal indoor air quality. Other eco-conscious features include a hydroponics garden, a refill station to reduce single-use plastics, and a comprehensive waste management and composting system. Community amenities include Zen-inspired landscaped areas, a Greenhouse Café, wellness facilities, and a full suite of lifestyle conveniences. projects.name: Farm Grove - The Valley by EMAAR
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Farm Grove by Emaar Properties which is located in The Valley. It offers an exclusive collection of 482 villas, available in 4-bedroom and 5-bedroom configurations, masterfully designed to combine modern sophistication with serene, nature-inspired living Nestled near Al Ain Dubai Road, this prime location ensures excellent connectivity to key attractions like Global Village, Dubai Outlet Mall, and IMG World of Adventure.

The villas are meticulously designed with elegant architecture and sophisticated interiors, creating refined living spaces that emphasize comfort, modernity, and tranquility. Farm Grove offers residents a perfect retreat, combining urban convenience with countryside charm.

Key Features

  • Entrance & Guard House: A secure entrance with a dedicated guard house ensures privacy and safety.
  • Infinity Pool: Relax at the stunning Infinity Pool, offering breathtaking views and a peaceful ambiance.
  • Yoga Areas: Rejuvenate in tranquil Yoga Areas designed for revitalizing sessions.
  • Fitness Studio: Stay active in the state-of-the-art Fitness Studio equipped with diverse workout options.
  • Kid's Play Area: A vibrant and safe space for kids to explore, play, and spark their creativity.
  • Grand Lawn: A spacious green area ideal for leisure, events, and outdoor activities.
  • Petting Zoo and Animal Farm: Interactive experiences with friendly animals for fun and education.
  • Community Farming Allotments: Dedicated plots for residents to grow fresh produce, promoting sustainable living.
  • Parks and Open Spaces: Expansive areas perfect for relaxing walks and connecting with nature.
  • Desert Majlis and Bonfire: Cozy areas for stargazing and enjoying bonfires under the desert sky.
  • Padel Court: A modern court for exciting padel matches.
  • Volleyball Court: A vibrant space for friendly matches and outdoor fun.

A Unique Lifestyle

Farm Grove embodies a self-sustaining community that fosters a unique farm-to-table philosophy. Residents can cultivate their own produce in private garden plots while enjoying world-class amenities. From golden beach areas to barbecue spots, retail outlets, and dining options, the community promotes meaningful connections and effortless living.

A Tranquil Retreat

projects.name: Védaire Residences - Meydan Avenue
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Védaire Residences, a 6 storey luxury residential development with a basement located in Meydan Avenue, Dubai. Positioned on a rare corner plot with three open sides, the development offers panoramic views of Burj Khalifa, Meydan Racecourse, and landscaped gardens. The project will feature 43 residential apartments and three commercial showrooms across five floors.

Védaire Residences is designed as a lifestyle-focused, low-density community, offering a range of thoughtfully integrated amenities aimed at enhancing the quality of life. These include a rooftop beach-style pool, zen garden, outdoor cinema, business center, fitness zone, yoga deck, library lounge, barbecue area, children's play area, and pet-friendly facilities. Each residence is equipped with smart home technology, expansive windows, and high-end finishes, blending contemporary urban design with a strong connection to nature through walkable outdoor spaces and lush gardens.

Strategically located just minutes from Downtown Dubai, DIFC, and Business Bay, the development combines connectivity with tranquility. The surrounding area is undergoing rapid growth, with the future Meydan metro station and the newly opened Nad Al Sheba Mall further enhancing accessibility and convenience. The development reflects Elton’s vision of creating human-scaled, community-centric living spaces within prime urban environments.

Védaire Residences - Meydan Avenue is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Dubai, valued at USD 15.0 million, at design. Developed by Elton Real Estate Development Llc. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

The project involves the renovation and conversion of existing Expo 2020 country pavilions into Al Waha Residences, a prestigious collection of 280 one- and two-bedroom apartments and lofts. These residences feature expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the stylish interiors with natural light. Located at the heart of Expo City Dubai, one of the region's most visionary urban developments, the residences benefit from seamless connectivity to major highways, airports, and business hubs.

Inspired by the architectural brilliance of Expo 2020’s iconic pavilions, Al Waha showcases cutting-edge design elements, shaded courtyards, and signature ‘Al Waha’ canopies. Each residence is meticulously crafted with high-quality finishes, built-in wardrobes, and premium materials, including sleek timber accents that enhance the refined living experience.

The loft-style apartments are particularly striking, offering double-height ceilings, statement staircases, and open-plan layouts that create a grand, spacious ambiance. Residents can enjoy access to a fully equipped gym, fitness center, swimming pool, parks, and dedicated play areas, promoting health, relaxation, and recreation.

Aligned with Expo City Dubai’s vision of sustainability, Al Waha integrates eco-friendly architecture, green spaces, and energy-efficient systems, ensuring a future-forward living environment.

Al Waha Residences - Expo City is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Dubai, valued at USD 90.7 million, at tender. Developed by Expo City Dubai. Lead consultant Hopkins Architects (Dubai). No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Kempinski Marina Residences - Dubai Marina
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a residential tower in Dubai Marina. The project comprises 453 apartments, ranging from one-bedroom to five-bedroom duplexes, situated in one of the last prime locations within the Dubai Marina area. The development comprises 3 Basements, a Ground floor, 4 Podium floors, 2 Hospitality Club floors, and 47 residential floors., encompassing one- to four-bedroom single and duplex apartments, sky villas, and seven penthouse suites. Each residence comes equipped with outdoor terraces offering sweeping views of the marina community and the Dubai skyline. Some units boast distinctive features such as plunge pools, hot tubs, and vertical gardens, arranged on stepped balconies, giving the tower a unique geometric design.

The amenities of the project, include a lounge, kids' club, and a state-of-the-art gym and fitness center with indoor and outdoor swimming pools, basketball, and paddle courts. Additionally, landscaped public spaces, parking, and retail units will be available. Residents will also have easy access to a variety of shopping and dining options.

Kempinski Marina Residences redefines luxury through a premier collection of amenities, including an outdoor adult infinity pool, a children's pool, a Zen-inspired garden, a golf simulator, an indoor games room and library, and a private 25-seater movie theatre. Additionally, a business center  and co-working space catering to the needs of residents seeking a productive and relaxing lifestyle.

Kempinski Marina Residences - Dubai Marina is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 200.0 million, at tender. Developed by Kempinski Residences S.A.. Lead consultant Arkiplan Consulting Architects & Engineers (Dubai),Arkiplan Consulting Architects & Engineers (Dubai); MEP consultant Arkiplan Consulting Architects & Engineers (Dubai). Main contractor Al Shafar National Contracting Llc (Snc); MEP contractor Al Shafar National Contracting Llc (Snc). Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a residential tower named 25H Heimat in Downtown Dubai. Offers a diverse range of living options, from studios to spacious 3-bedroom apartments with a study as well as Duplex Penthouses, offering unobstructed vistas of the Burj Khalifa. This residential tower spans over 74 floors including a ground floor.
25h Heimat, the brand's debut residential masterpiece, presents a variety of retro-style units, ranging from studios to 3-bedroom apartments with a study, as well as exclusive duplex penthouses spanning up to 3,000 sqft. Beyond the conventional residential offerings, 25h Heimat offers a range of distinctive amenities, including a coveted 63rd-floor sky lounge with rooftop yoga and a chess area, a music room, a podcast studio, a padel court, and mini-golf for fitness enthusiasts, along with a cutting-edge hybrid co-working space.
25h Heimat at Downtown features retro-themed units and a selection of unique amenities, including a 63rd-floor sky lounge and a modern co-working space. It represents not only a place to live but a transformative lifestyle experience, seamlessly integrating the renowned hospitality DNA of 25hours into everyday life, creating a space that celebrates individuality and innovation.
Nestled in the core of Downtown Dubai, residents will enjoy uninterrupted views of the iconic Burj Khalifa and the vibrant Downtown Boulevard. Located a mere 5-minute drive from the renowned Dubai Mall, 25h Heimat acts as your gateway to culture, shopping, and endless entertainment. Moreover, it is just 5 minutes away from Business Bay and a convenient 15-minute drive from Dubai International Airport. This prime location ensures that residents remain seamlessly connected to the city's heartbeat.

The project emphasizes sustainability and modern living, featuring energy-efficient lighting, electric vehicle charging stations, and advanced waste recycling systems. Amenities include:

  • A 4,200 sq ft gym and spa
  • Outdoor cinema
  • Dedicated kids’ room
  • Multipurpose room and meeting spaces
  • Co-working areas and concierge services

Located along Sheikh Zayed Road, Bellagio offers seamless connectivity to Dubai’s key business hubs, shopping centers, and entertainment zones. It is designed to provide a luxurious yet eco-friendly lifestyle within a well-connected urban community.

projects.name: Bluewaters Bay - Bluewaters Island Development
projects.description:
The project involves the development of two distinct structures: Bluewaters Bay Tower 1, consisting of 53 floors and an approximate 360 units, and Bluewaters Bay Tower 2, comprising 44 floors and an estimated 312 units. Both towers will feature a variety of living options, including 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, along with 5-bedroom penthouses. The striking architectural design of the towering structures embodies a contemporary interpretation of opulent coastal living, drawing inspiration from Dubai's lifestyle to capture breathtaking views of the waterfront and the city.

The project is situated on Bluewaters Island, adjacent to Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), this exclusive development offers unobstructed vistas of the encompassing landscape, including the magnificent Ain Dubai, the world's largest observation wheel. With accessible road and sea routes, residents can effortlessly access their favorite hotspots.

Rising prominently within Dubai Marina and the JBR skyline, this development's remarkable architectural composition grants it a commanding stature. The seamless integration of a transparent façade and expansive terraces bridges the gap between indoor and outdoor spaces, enabling residents to fully immerse themselves in the tranquil beach surroundings.

The waterfront residences are replete with exceptional amenities, ensuring an unparalleled living experience. Each residence showcases exquisite interior design, featuring spacious layouts and terraces that provide awe-inspiring panoramic views.
The grand entrance of the building boasts a dazzling double-height lobby with vistas of the city skyline illuminated at night.

The first level features tennis courts, a fully equipped fitness center, and an infinity pool offering stunning views of both the beach and the city skyline. The development will also include retail and F&B outlets on the podium level, along with outstanding amenities such as a children’s play area, and barbecue facilities.

projects.name: Development of Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary
projects.description:
The project involves the development of Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, which seeks to enhance the sanctuary’s ecosystem and biodiversity. Aims to enhance biodiversity, preserve the sustainability of natural habitats, and reinforce the sanctuary’s position as a premier sustainable eco-tourism destination offering a unique and integrated experience that further enriches quality of life for residents and visitors alike.

The project is split into 2 phases. Phase one will cover approximately 6.4 square kilometres of the sanctuary.

New Features:

  • Creation of a new mangrove lake
  • Development of North Edge Lake
  • Addition of reed ponds

Green Spine Construction: A central ecological corridor will be developed.

Water Bodies Expansion:

  • 74 hectares of water bodies to be introduced
  • Represents a 144% increase in water coverage

Environmental Benefits:

  • 60% increase in carbon dioxide absorption
  • Supports climate change mitigation efforts
  • 10 hectares of new mudflats (salt flats) to promote local biodiversity and ecosystem support.

The second phase, to be implemented at a later stage.

  • Visitor centre showcasing flora, fauna, and educational exhibits
  • Birdwatching towers, restaurants, kiosks, and recreational zones
  • 5.6 km cycling tracks and 3 km walking trails through natural landscapes
  • 23 hectares of landscaping
  • Facilities to host events and activities
Development of Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is a greenfield zoo and animal reserve project in Dubai, valued at USD 177.0 million, at under construction (2.0 percent complete). projects.name: Two Signature Villas by 25 Degrees - Palm Jumeirah
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of two ultra-luxury Signature Villas on a beachfront plot near the tip of one of the fronds on Palm Jumeirah, Dubai. These custom-built villas are poised to set a new benchmark for super prime living in the region. The development distinguishes itself by being constructed from the ground up on a previously vacant site, rather than being a renovation of existing properties.

Each villa is uniquely designed to embody a distinct architectural identity. One features floating planes, layered textures, and deep spatial composition, while the other is shaped by smooth, curvilinear forms that blend seamlessly into the horizon. Together, they reflect a harmonious balance between indoor and outdoor living, showcasing double-height lounges, sculptural staircases, and full-height glazing.

The villas are curated as sensory retreats, incorporating infinity pools that stretch toward the Arabian Gulf, sunken seating areas surrounded by reflection pools, cascading water features, and organically designed landscaping to evoke a tranquil atmosphere. They also include formal and informal lounges, ocean-view master suites with spa-style his-and-her bathrooms, expansive walk-in wardrobes, and state-of-the-art amenities.

Each residence features a private cinema, fitness suite, wellness spa, and an exclusive automotive gallery. Rooftop amenities include a plunge pool, alfresco BBQ lounge, and an open-air cinema, all framed by panoramic views of the Gulf and Dubai’s skyline. With direct beach access and bespoke European finishes, the project aims to cater to the growing population of ultra-high-net-worth individuals seeking elite property options in Dubai.

Two Signature Villas by 25 Degrees - Palm Jumeirah is a greenfield low rise (1 -3) project in Dubai, valued at USD 80.0 million, at design. Developed by 25 Degrees. Lead consultant Killa Design,Killa Design. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: DO Hotels & Residences - Dubai Islands
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of DO Hotels & Residences – Dubai Islands, a premium mixed-use development that blends hospitality, residential, retail, and entertainment functions within a waterfront setting. The development is designed to deliver a unique lifestyle experience centered around the theme of music, AI-powered personalization, and luxury living.

At its core, the project features an AI-powered, music-themed boutique hotel under the One/AD brand, inspired by Amr Diab’s “Live the Beat” philosophy. It combines immersive soundscapes, bold contemporary design, and advanced technology to offer an unprecedented hospitality concept. The hotel includes fully equipped recording studios and services designed for travelers who seek a soulful, interactive experience.

Complementing the hotel are elegant residential units including spacious apartments and penthouses, each equipped with smart home technology that enables residents to manage lighting, climate, and security from their devices. Designed for those seeking a more permanent lifestyle, the residences offer expansive views of the sea, city, and marina.

The broader development integrates retail and dining outlets, from fine dining restaurants to boutique stores, as well as leisure and wellness facilities, including gyms, swimming pools, and community centers. Open green spaces, landscaped gardens, walking and cycling paths, and a waterfront promenade enhance the urban experience by promoting wellness and social engagement.

The strategic location of Meydan Horizon provides easy access to Dubai's main arteries, facilitating swift travel to Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai, and other key destinations within minutes. Offering an exclusive collection of 1 to 4-bedroom residences, The Element blends modern sophistication with timeless elegance, ensuring each home is surrounded by unparalleled vistas and a harmonious ambiance.

Immerse yourself in a lifestyle that perfectly balances relaxation and vitality, with state-of-the-art amenities designed to enhance every aspect of daily life. Unwind in the sky garden, where a resort-style infinity pool meets stunning city views, or stay active in the aqua fitness center, outdoor gym, and cross-fit training areas. For social gatherings, outdoor barbecue stations and dining areas set the stage for memorable moments with family and friends. Meanwhile, premium co-working spaces and business lounges provide the ideal setting for productivity and focus.

The Element at SOBHA One is thoughtfully crafted to elevate modern living with world-class amenities, including a rooftop lounge, jacuzzi, clubhouse, landscaped gardens, yoga decks, and wellness zones. A dedicated kids’ play area ensures fun for the little ones, while outdoor lounges create peaceful spaces to unwind. With its seamless integration of nature, luxury, and convenience, The Element is an exquisite retreat in the heart of Dubai, offering a lifestyle unlike any other.

The Element by Sobha One - Ras Al Khor is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 151.7 million, at design. Developed by Sobha Realty. The project involves the construction of a residential tower with 14 floors, including a ground floor and parking level. Covering a large area of 298,935.90 sq ft, this is Samana Developers' first project in Dubai Sports City, conveniently connected to Al Khail Road and Hessa Street.

Samana Golf Views offers 243 apartments, including 128 studios, 52 one-bedroom, 60 two-bedroom, and 3 three-bedroom options. Apartments can be furnished or unfurnished, as per residents' choice. The standout features include private pools in some apartments, a main swimming pool, a spacious leisure pool deck, a kids' pool, and a play area. The site also offers a VR Golf Experience, a sauna, sports courts, a skate park, jogging track, outdoor cinema, barbeque area, indoor and outdoor gyms, and a peaceful walking river. Standard 24-hour security is provided. The development neighbors The Els Club Golf Course, designed by Ernie Els. A well-designed skate park adds to the recreational facilities, promoting fitness in an enjoyable way. This project embodies a healthy and enjoyable lifestyle within Dubai Sports City.

Samana Golf Views - Dubai Sports City is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 82.0 million, at under construction (8.0 percent complete). Developed by Samana Developers. projects.name: Onda by Kasco - Business Bay

ONDA is an exclusive 23-floor freehold community offering 348 thoughtfully designed residences, including 85 studios, 190 one-bedroom plus apartments, 69 two-bedroom units, and four luxurious three-bedroom penthouses, crafted with a focus on spaciousness and elegance.

It features state-of-the-art wellness amenities such as a running track, advanced gym, premium spa with a cold plunge and sauna, and indoor and outdoor swimming pools for year-round fitness and leisure. Wellness cafés provide tranquil spaces for relaxation and rejuvenation. The top-floor three-bedroom apartments feature private pools, blending luxury with health-conscious design.

Conveniently located, ONDA offers easy access to Dubai’s iconic attractions like the Museum of the Future, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, Dubai Airport, and Jumeirah Beach. Landscaped gardens and communal spaces create opportunities for social gatherings and foster a sense of community.

Designed for diverse residents, from professionals to families, ONDA balances quality finishes with a wellness-focused lifestyle. The incorporation of eco-friendly materials and energy-efficient systems will be a hallmark of the development, aligning with global trends towards sustainable living.

The project also offers world-class amenities, including the esteemed InterContinental Mina Al Arab Resort, a health club, spa, swimming pools, a fitness center, and a variety of dining options, everyday life takes on the feel of a perpetual holiday.

The project transforms Ras Al Khaimah's urban landscape by seamlessly integrating urban architecture, promoting connectivity, and fostering a sense of community. The interconnected towers feature skywalks providing majestic views, while an integrated podium ensures convenient access to signature amenities.

These amenities encompass a Zen garden, a Spa Club, a state-of-the-art gymnasium, a nature-surrounded yoga studio, indoor and outdoor cinema, sky pools, diverse culinary experiences from casual to fine dining, retail shops, a miniature golf course, promenades, a safe and creative space for children, recreational play courts, fitness trails, and pet parks.

Moreover, residents can enjoy the exclusive maritime-inspired beach club, offering a unique seaside experience with echoes of yachting elegance, overlooking a lagoon beach.

The project involves the construction of Elite Beachside by Damac, located in Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah. Elite Beachside by DAMAC Properties is set to transform luxury living on Al Marjan Island. With its prime waterfront location, premium features, and a variety of residential options, this development promises a lifestyle of comfort and sophistication.

From resort-inspired amenities to private beachfront living, every detail has been crafted to deliver an elevated standard of living. Don’t miss the opportunity to be part of one of Ras Al Khaimah’s most prestigious coastal communities. Register now to secure your place in this premier beachfront destination.

Amenities

  • Exclusive Beach Access: Enjoy the serenity of a private beach with direct shoreline access, offering a peaceful, resort-like lifestyle every day.
  • Luxury Resort-Style Features: Designed to meet every comfort, the development provides a refined ambiance through amenities such as high-end swimming pools, state-of-the-art fitness centers, and spa facilities, mirroring the experience of a 5-star resort.
  • Recreational Spaces: A wide array of leisure amenities will be available, including pools, gyms, and spa services, ensuring a well-rounded lifestyle that balances relaxation with wellness.
  • Dining and Retail Options: The community will feature a selection of dining venues and boutique retail outlets, offering residents convenient access to fine cuisine and shopping without leaving the neighborhood.
Elite Beachside by Damac - Al Marjan Island is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Ras Al Khaimah, valued at USD 120.0 million, at design. Developed by Damac Properties Co. Llc. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

This nature-inspired sanctuary, overlooking crystal lagoons, provides a peaceful living experience without sacrificing urban convenience. Designed with a ground floor plus 4 parking levels plus additional 28 floors and roof, Parkway includes approximately 274 units, a mix of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments.

Amenities include an Entertainment Lounge, Mini Putt Golf, Club Lounge, Kids Play Zone, Yoga Sanctuary, Multi-Sports Court, Family Pool with Juice Bar, BBQ Terrace, Children's Play Studio, Fitness Gym, Outdoor Cinema, and Owners Lounge.

Located in the heart of Meydan Horizon, Parkway offers a lifestyle that seamlessly blends nature with city life. Just minutes from iconic landmarks such as the Meydan Racecourse, residents benefit from proximity to top schools, healthcare facilities, and leisure options, while enjoying easy access to Downtown Dubai and DIFC.

Designed with a sleek, minimalist architectural style, the buildings feature expansive glass facades that offer abundant natural light and maximize views of the surrounding coastline. Strategically situated along the Yas Bay beachfront, Opula provides direct access to a vibrant promenade, and close proximity to Abu Dhabi’s cultural attractions and world-class amenities. The project also features state-of-the-art facilities, including an infinity pool, modern fitness center, and landscaped spaces, enhancing both lifestyle quality and rental appeal. Opula is being marketed as a prime opportunity for investors and homeowners, combining luxury living with competitive pricing and an attractive payment plan. This premium development is designed to offer a modern and sustainable lifestyle within the vibrant and culturally rich suburb. The development will feature contemporary homes, high-end amenities, and green surroundings, providing an exceptional living experience.

Amenities include ample parking space, BBQ areas, a community hall, gardens and parks, a maze garden, outdoor and indoor sports facilities, a yoga and meditation deck, a state-of-the-art gymnasium, picnic areas, a restaurant and café, tennis and volleyball courts, and nearby schools and institutes. projects.name: Mar Casa - Dubai Maritime City
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of the Mar Casa luxury residential tower located in Dubai Maritime City. The 52-floor tower seamlessly blends the beauty of the sea with modern metropolis design. The project comprises 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, and luxury penthouses with floor-to-ceiling windows and balconies, offering panoramic views of the ocean and Dubai's skyline. The unique sea wave-inspired façade creates a harmonious connection between land and sea, positioning Mar Casa as a pioneer in emotional luxury development.

Mar Casa offers a smart and sustainable lifestyle, featuring living spaces with daylight integration, energy-efficient light fixtures, superior indoor air quality, and energy-efficient MEP systems. A full floor of world-class recreational amenities includes an indoor and outdoor resident's lounge, padel court, yoga and breakout spaces, kids play area, and kids club. A roof-top infinity pool with breathtaking views offers the ideal space for relaxation, while a separate children's pool and beach-inspired pool with splash areas are also available on the main recreational floor.

Every apartment and penthouse at Mar Casa is a smart home equipped with advanced IP intercoms, smart access and lighting control systems, and premium-brand appliances. The luxurious units offer a wide range of options, with one-bedroom units ranging from 740-1265 sq. ft. Two-bedroom apartments and duplexes range between 1100-3285 sq. ft., while three-bedroom apartments and duplexes are available from 1850-4170 sq. ft. The ultra-luxury Executive and Royal duplex penthouses offer between 2780-5830 sq. ft. of built-up area.

Mar Casa is perfectly connected to Dubai's old city, financial center, and Jumeirah area, with Dubai Downtown landmarks like the Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa only a ten-minute drive away. A sustainable development in line with the UAE's vision for a healthy environment, Mar Casa presents exceptional amenities, smart and sustainable infrastructure, and world-class construction quality.

Mar Casa - Dubai Maritime City is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 300.0 million, at under construction. Developed by Deyaar Property Management Llc. projects.name: Masaar Central
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Masaar Central, a retail and lifestyle hub situated at the heart of the forested Masaar master community in Sharjah’s Suyoh district. Spanning 53,000 square feet of gross leasable area (GLA), Masaar Central is designed to serve as the social, retail, and wellness core of the overall development. The hub will include a mix of retail outlets, dining experiences, wellness facilities, and educational services.

Anchor tenants at Masaar Central include a Carrefour supermarket, a Wellfit gym, and the Bright Star RGS nursery. The first floor will feature a restaurant, an open cafe, and a reading room, providing visitors with a tranquil environment to relax and enjoy the scenic views. The ground floor will include viewing platforms, a multipurpose hall, and a prayer room to cater to various visitor needs. Over 4,500 trees, including olive, apple, pomegranate, and grape varieties, have been planted to enhance the rocky mountain landscape, creating a green oasis.

Additional nearby attractions include an open theatre and play areas for children, making the overall area a family-friendly destination. A football stadium, situated 650 meters above sea level, promises cooler and humidity-free playing conditions for sports enthusiasts. Additionally, a 100-room hotel will provide luxurious accommodation options for tourists visiting the vicinity.
